newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain share index up 4.89 points in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain share index up 4.89 points in thin trade.

text.p: Bahrain's share index ended the week to Thursday 4.89 points higher at 1,350.01 points in lacklustre trade, Bahrain Stock Exchange figures show.
Trading volume dropped sharply to 1.38 million shares worth 303,867 dinars ($806,000) from 3.15 million shares worth 571,018 dinars the previous week.
The bourse said 102,131 Bahrain Maritime and Mercantile International shares worth 61,279 dinars changed hands in the week. It closed unchanged at 600 fils.
The exchange said 94,183 Investcorp shares worth 48,908 dinars were traded at $1.40 per share, up three cents on the previous week.
Shares of 18 firms of the 39 registered at the bourse were traded in 72 transactions, it added.
Bahrain's market is open to nationals in Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Oman, Bahrain and the United Arab Emirates. Certain firms are also open to foreign investors.
